$comment: CONSOLE-UI vectors, pinned by pf-console-ui's Rust tests: the Skia console draws these on every platform. Sibling of deeplink-vectors.json, same rules: this file is the contract, and a value absent here is a value no client may assume.
$shell_tabs: Version 3: the console's top-level tabs, in strip order. The Skia shell draws them on every platform, so its Rust twin pins them; Apple and Android hold no copy.
$settings_sections: Version 4: the Settings tab's sections, in tab order: the categories every client's settings use, plus Presets. The Skia shell draws them on every platform, so its Rust twin pins them.
$motion_springs: Version 3: the redesign's motion table (design section 3). Springs are integrator-dependent, so this pins parameters, not sampled positions. nav carries the push/pop geometry too: Back mid-push retargets the same spring (interruptible). The Skia shell animates every screen, so its Rust twin pins it.
$pinned_key: Version 6: a pinned card's row key (HostRow.key) is the host's key, a NUL, then the preset id. The session, Apple and Android producers build it; the console splits it back to the host key.
